(315)༄༅/ /bla med sngags chos kyi snying po'i bcud len lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (315)༄༅// bla med sngags chos kyi snying po'i bcud len lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(316)༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī kā la tsakra ye/ mi 'gyur bde chen stong gzugs phyag rgya che// zung 'jug ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba// rnam kun mchog ldan rnam pa thams cad mkhyen// dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor lor 'dud// bla med sngags lam nying khu mchog /smin 'phel byang chub chen po'i bar// rim pa lam zab ces bya ba// bla ma'i man ngag bzhin bshad bya/ rnal 'byor pa bde ba'i gdan la mnyam par bzhag ste bdud rtsi myang nas// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// bdag gi phung po khams skye mched// yul bcas ma dag 'dzin pa'i cha// spros bral rang bzhin rnam dag pa// gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos// rang snang dag pa spyi bo'i gtsug /bde ba chen po'i snying gi dkyil// khams lnga ldan pa lag gi mthil// phyogs bral khyab brdal nam mkha'i (317)dbyings// 'byung lnga 'od kyi 'khor lo'i dbus// padma zla nyi sgra gcan ste// rig pa hūm̐ las kun rdzob dus// don dam 'khor lo'i bdag nyid che// dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas ni// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dngos// rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka /kun byed rgyal po kun tu bzang*// sngo sangs de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku// zhi khro 'dres pa chags pa'i nyams// spyan gsum mche bzhi'i myu gu mdzes// rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag sham can// dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag cing*// 'tshogs mar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lter// rigs bdag bskyed mdzad rgyal bas brgyan// thor cog g.yon du zla tshes dang*// rtse mor nor bu'i 'od 'bar ba// lta bas mi tshugs bsam mi khyab// phyag gnyis sor mo mthe bong nas// brtsi rim ser dkar dmar nag ljang*// phyag sor rtsa ba nas brtsams te// tshig phred rim gsum nag dmar dkar// phyag mthil padma ltar dmar zhing*// phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu bcas// yum (318)la rnam rol phyag rgyas 'khyud// zhabs g.yon dkar po g.yas dmar po// bskum dang brkyang ba'i 'og tu ni// dkar po dbang ldan mig gsum pa// rtse gsum thod pa 'dzin kha sbub// dmar po 'dod lha me tog gi*/mda' lnga gzhu 'dzin gan rkyal mnan// dbang ldan 'dod lha'i chung ma yis// gus pas zhabs sor dpral btud de// lag gi brten yang g.yo med par// ri dbang ltar brjid der 'khyud pa'i// sna tshogs yum gyur gser gyi mdog

/spyan gsum khro 'dzum dbu skra grol// phyag rgya lngas spras gri thod 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang mnyam par rol// rdor pad e waṃ zung 'jug snyoms// mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs yab yum sku// 'od zer ye shes me lnga 'bar// de ltar gsal ba'i sku yi gnas// spyi mgrin thugs lte gsang gtsug tor// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho swā hā drug /dkar dmar nag ser ljang mthing mdog /yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer ni// mkha' khams ji srid kun khyab ste// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// rab 'byams rgyud sde bzhi drug gaṃ /yi dam rab 'byams rgya mtsho dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags// dpa' bo rnal 'byor zhing skyong ba// chos srung dam can tshogs bcas kun// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs shing*// de rnams la ni mchod pa'i sprin// nyer spyod 'dod yon sha bdud rtsi// snyoms 'jug bde chen mnyam pa nyid// mchod dgyes dkon mchog rtsa gsum tshogs// bla ma dus kyi 'khor lor thim// dbyer med du ma ro gcig pas// kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bur gyur// (319)de nas gus pa'i yid kyis rtsa gcig pas sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor phur tshugs su gsol ba btab pa ni/ gang la rgyu dang mtshan nyid med// g.yo dang de bzhin ris med pas// ka la tsakrar mngon brjod pa// gnyis med de la gsol ba 'debs// de bzhin dus 'khor bde chen po// sku gsum mchog dang dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje gsum mchog rdo rje'i dbyings// 'gyur ba med la gsol ba 'debs// phra rags rdul gyi chos nyid 'das// bra phab pa yi rang bzhin can// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// phyag rgya chen mor gsol ba 'debs/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma yang*// pha ma gnyen dang grogs bzang po// khyod ni sdig 'phrog phan byed mgon// khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs// khyod mchog 'ba' zhig yon tan gnas// skyon bcom dman rnams mgon gyur khyod// yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i gtso// bla mar bdag ni skyabs su mchi'o// skye rga 'chi dang na ba yi// chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba// mi zad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// mgon pos bdag ni bsgral du gsol/

zhes pas gsol ba nan tan du gdab/ de ltar tshig sha lo ka bdun la snga ma gsum ni 'phags 'gre la dri med 'od na gnas pa rgyud tshig dar phyi ma gcig po yang 'gyur chad kyis 'phags 'grel la lar mi gsal yang*/ dus 'khor rgyud las phyung ba zhig dang*/ bzhi pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshig dang*/ lnga pa drug pa (320)zung ni dus 'khor bsdus rgyud nang le'i mthar dang*/ 'jam dpal zhal lung tshig sgros mthun pa las blangs pa ste rgyud tshig sha stag go /de mthar thal mo sbyar te/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi// dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud// mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba// ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems de 'gyur med gang*// dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni// mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod// ces pa lan gsum du gsol ba gtab/ dpal ldan bla ma dus 'khor lo// yab yum mdzod spu nas 'od dkar// zla zhun 'dra byung bdag dpral nas// zhugs shing phyi nang lus kun sbyangs// dbyibs snang dga' ba bum dbang gi/ smin grol sbyang thob las kun byas// bla ma yab yum sbyor mtshams nas// dkar dmar 'dres pa thig le'i rgyun// bdag lce steng babs lce chung nas// dbu ma'i nang brgyud lus kun khengs// sngags mched khyad dga' gsang dbang gis// smin grol sbyangs thob las kun byas// bla ma yab yum thugs ka nas// lnga ldan 'od zer srang bu bzhin// bdag gi snying gar yongs thim nas// phyi nang 'od zer drwa bas g.yogs// chos thob mchog dga' sher dbang gis// smin grol sbyangs thob las kun byas// bla ma yab yum snying dbus nas// gsal dong rab mtsher rgyal ba'i sku// mi 'gyur bde bar mchon gang ba// bdag gi gtsug nas snying gar thim// nyer thob lhan dga' dbang bzhi (321)pa'i// smin grol sbyangs thob las kun byas// de ltar ting nge 'dzin dbang yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag nas ci nus su blang bar bya'o// de nas bla ma dus 'khor lo// yab yum rang gi spyi bor byon// 'od zhu bdag gi sgo gsum dang*// dus 'khor sku gsung thugs mnyam pas// rang nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag

/dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor lo// me long sngags kyi pra phab bzhin// rdul bral ye shes sku ru gyur/ de ltar lha sku cha med rnam pa gsal ba la rnam rtog gzhan spangs te ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag cing*/ gal te rnam rtog 'phro ba sel phyir rang sngags bzla bar spro na/ dus 'khor thugs ka nas 'od 'phros// snang ba dag pa 'od gsal zhing*// 'gro kun dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku// ye shes rol ba chen por gyur// zhes snang srid dag par bltas te mnyam par bzhag go /yang oṃ ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ swā hā/ zhes pa zla skyon lnga spangs te ngag bzlas sam yid bzlas sogs ji ltar 'dod pa bya'o// mthar thun bsdu na/ snang srid zhing khams lha tshogs kun// 'od zhu rang nyid yum kyang yab// rab phra'i thig ler gyur yal stong*// spar yang rang nyid lha skur ldang*// de ltar rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod na skabs 'dir yan lag drug gang rigs bsgom par bya'o// de yang 'dir yan lag drug snying po'i don du gnad du dril nas gdan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa ni/ bsam stan gyi gdan la lus drang zhing skyil krung khu tshur brla bzhag sogs byed pa cing gnang dang ldan pas rlung ro legs par bsal te so bar nas 'bras thar tsam du byas te (322)rlung re zhig rang babs su bzhag /mig ha cang gi bzlog pa ma yin par smin phrag thad du 'byed btsum ran ba mi g.yo bar nam mkha'i mun pa nag thing nge bar gtad la sems rnam rtog gi spros pa dang bral bar de ltar g.yo med gsum ldan du bzhag par bya ste/ sor sdud skabs stong gzugs shar rung de la ched gnyer med pa nam mkha' la gtso bo dang*/ bsam gtan ni stong gzugs mi shar tshe nam mkha' dang shar phyin stong gzugs gtso bor byas te gnas gzhan gcig pa nyid do// de yang du ba smig rgyu me khyer mar me mkha' snang ser dkar dmar nag dang glog 'od thig le thig le chen por grags pa'i rtag pa snang kun stong gzugs zhes sems la sems ma mchis pa'i stong nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs 'khrul shes kyis ma bslad pa'i ma 'khrul ba'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi phyag rgya chen po rnam pa thams cad pa ste/

de ni dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi chos skad yang dag pa'o// de ltar sor bsam la goms pa'am ma goms kyang rung*/ thog ma dbugs rang babs la brda' 'gyur rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci nus su 'bad cing de nas dal gyis rlung ji nus 'gog kyin rdor bzlas sbyar la de ltas mthar bum pa can rang grub tu yong bar bzhed la/ rlung 'gog pa'i rdor bzlas ni 'gog bzlas lta bu ma yin gyi rngub dgang btang gsum pa sdoms par 'bru gsum tshar gcig dang sbyar ba las mang mi dgos shing*/ drag rlung bum pa can sogs la gzhil zhes 'byung ba rang dang dgong pa dang btang ba'i bar mtshams su las khyad par can byed rung*/ ngo bo ni dgong pa las logs su med cing*/ de ltar rdor bzlas dang*/ (323)sbyar ba'i rlung sbyor ni srog rtsol dngos dang stong gzugs dang bsre ba na thun mong ma yin pa'o// de ltar srog rtsol gyi nus pas rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim pa'i bya ba lte ba man khyad grub nas/ slar 'khor lo gong ma rnams dang gsang ba bcas par bzhugs gnas thim gsum khyad par can gyis dbyid thig kha sbyor la byang nas yas brtan pas dang po'i sa thob par byed pa ni 'dzin pa ste de'i man ngag zur du byas pa yod kyang grub pa'i slob dpon phal ches ni man ngag srog rtsol kho nas rung la des grub ba'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa yin par bzhed do// de nas rjes dran dngos ni/ phyag rgya gsum la brten yas brten gyi dga' ba bzhi pa'i mthar thug rjes dran bcu drug gi yon tan yongs su grub nas/ de'i 'bras bu'i tshul du ting nge 'dzin mas brten gyi dga' ba bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa yan lag bdun dbang phyug brgyad zung 'jug nyer gsum gyi yon tan grub pa rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob pa rnams dngos gnas kyi sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rim pa dang*/ de yan lag phyi ma gsum mos pa lam du byed pa'i de'i rgyu tshogs khyad par can sgrub par gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la 'bad par bsngags te/

de yang rang nyid dus 'khor yab yum du gsal btab pa'i rang gis lus dbus su rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan mda' smyug tsam lte ba man ljang gu de yan chad mthing ga g.yas g.yon ro rkyang dkar dmar dbu ma las 'dab 'gyur phra ba yas sna sna bug g.yas g.yon dang mas nad dbu mar chud pa ste dbu ma'i lte 'og sor bzhi'i mtshams tshangs pa'i me dbyug pa'i dbyibs can lte bar hoḥser snying gar hūm̐ sngon yas snar haṃ can ba nu lta bu ste/ (324)de yang zar ma'i 'bras bu ltar zlum pa'i dbus ba nu ltar cung zad nar re 'phyangs pas dbu ma'i yas snar bkab pa'o// de nas rlung ro bsal/ rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan la/ dmigs pa ro rkyang rlung rgyud dbu ma'i mas sna rlung zhugs tshangs pa'i me 'bar/ ho yig la reg hoḥyig las me ser shas che ba'i kha dog drug pa 'bar/ rim pas je mthor song ste snying ga'i hūm̐ bsreg spyi bo'i haṃ can la reg bdud rtsi zla zhun ltar dkar 'tsher 'od zer 'phro ba'am snying ga'i hūm̐ gsos te lte ba'i hoḥl thim zhing*/ de yang me bdun la hoḥcan la rtse reg tsam bar mi chad dang thig le rgyab nas hoḥyig bar mi chad par bab ste thim pa 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa ltar bya ste/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i thun mgor rlung ro legs par bsal/ bar rlung btang ba'i skabs kun tu rlung zhabs 'dzin pa dang*/ mthar thun bzhag skabs lus g.yas su gcud de thig le dkar cha kun spyi bor haṃ la thim/ g.yon du gcud dmar cha kun lte ba'i hoḥl thim/ de nas thig le dkar dmar 'dres par bsam la rlung gi dug 'don hag spug yang dag par byas rjes dmigs med dang*/ rlung zhabs par rlung du 'dzin pa rnams bla ma'i man ngag bar ma chad pa yin la/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la yang shin tu gal che bar rje btsun mi las mnyam med sgam po bar nged kyi a thung 'di bsgom dang da bzod ngo bo mthong gsung bas kyang nges par mtshon/

lhag tu lha sku gtum mo 'bar 'dzag kun stong gzugs dang bsre ba ni dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rdzogs rim khyad chos phul du byung ba'o// de nas thun mtshams la (325)'jug par 'dor tshe/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// snyon med dus kyi 'khor lo ston// bla ma la gus snying brtse ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /ces sogs smon lam ci rigs pa bya la de ltar rdzogs rim bsgoms pa'i mtha' 'am mi bsgom yang rung*/ thun las ldang bar 'dod tshe dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas btab pa yang nges par ma chad par gces so// de ltar bla med rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi nying khu lam zab khyad par can 'di rtsa ba'i khung 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa 'jig rten 'byung gnas sbas ba'i man ngag dpal rgwa lo dang*/ rgyal ba zhang*/ yang dgon pa rnams kyi thugs dam yang snying zhang gi bka' 'bum dang*/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos su che thang du ma mdzad pa nyid gzhir bzhag /de yang zhang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor los bsgyur ba'i chos can dang*/ rdo rje 'chang du byas pa gdams so can/ ri chos su bde mchog tu byas pa yod kyang 'dir dus 'khor du byas pa dang*/ dus 'khor lhan skyes rol pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung rje btsun sgrol mgon gyi khrid rim du drangs pa'i don bzhin la rgyud kyi shes pas bla ma'i man ngag rgyud don ma 'khrul bas kha cung zad bskangs te byas pas nor 'khrul med la (326)zhal lung rgyun ma chad pas byin rlabs ma nyams pa dang*/ sbyor drug gdan thog gcig pa'i myong khrid kyi srol ka ma nyams pa byung ba'o// de ltar rgyal ba'i dbang phyug gi/

bka' gsang rgyud sde kun mthar thug /thugs kyi phrin las phul byung chos// lam zab shing rta'i srol 'di rmad// tshul 'dir bdag gis 'bad bgyis dge mchis kun// 'gro mgon bla ma dgyes mdzad mkha' mnyam 'gror// yongs bsngo re mthu tshe dbang rgyal ba yis// go 'phang yid bzhin nor bu'i gnas thob shog /ces bla med sngags chos kyi snying po'i bcud len lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba 'di ni sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser 'phyo ba gang gi spyi phud yongs kyi 'dren pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgyu 'phrul 'gog pa med pa'i rang gdangs rje 'gro mgon rin po che sprul pa'i sku mchog kun mkhyen rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta'i zhal snga nas gong gi bka' stsal dgyes pa bsgrub pa'i slad du rang gi nyams len snying po dang mthun par rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i bgrang bya rnga chen gyi lo sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus bzang por kong yul zang kha lcugs ri 'od gsal lding du rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje dpal 'bar gyis sbyar ba sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
